## Seven-area review

| Area | Question | Result | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Correctness | Does each component satisfy requirements? | | |
| Security | Are secrets excluded and input validated? | | |
| Error handling | Are failures and missing data handled? | | |
| Test coverage | Are happy-path and Not Found/edge cases covered? | | |
| Code clarity | Is logic clear and self-explanatory? | | |
| DRY | Is duplicated logic removed? | | |
| Dependency safety | Are dependencies and audits safe? | | |
